meta.title: AI Coding Plan & Token Plan Tracker

vendors.name: Cursor
vendors.billing: credit pool + usage multiplier; Auto mode unlimited (no credit burn)
vendors.notes: Bugbot add-on $20 (Pro) / $40 (Teams). Non-Auto agent requests add $0.25/MTok. Official guidance: daily agent users ~$60-100/mo, power users $200+. Composer 2.5 + Mission Control UI preview shown late Jul 2026.

vendors.name: Claude Code
vendors.billing: via Claude subscription or API per token (no standalone sub)
deadlines: 2026-08-17 legacy Workbench + 3 experimental prompt-tool APIs retire
vendors.notes: 5h rolling window + weekly cap; Max tiers have an extra model-specific weekly cap. Quota shared across chat/Code/Cowork, no rollover. Rule of thumb: above ~$7/day API spend, Max subscription is cheaper. Cache reads ~1/10 of input price. Sonnet 5 is default model (native 1M ctx, SWE-Bench 82.1%). Opus 5 released 2026-07-24.

vendors.name: GitHub Copilot
vendors.billing: GitHub AI Credits (1 credit = $0.01), token-metered since 2026-06-01
vendors.notes: First full cycle closed 2026-06-30: heavy agentic seats saw 10x-50x bill surge ($600-3000/mo). Completions & Next Edit unlimited/free. Model menu spread ~60x. MAI-Code-1-Flash ($0.75/$4.50) cheapest, GA for Business/Enterprise. Grok 4.5 added 2026-07-28. Credits do not roll over. Cloud agent also consumes Actions minutes. Agent Skills went preview -> GA within a month.

vendors.name: OpenAI Codex

plans.included: per 5h window: Sol 10-100 / Terra 25-200 / Luna 250-2000 messages

vendors.notes: WAU >5M. Local + cloud tasks share one credit pool. After the 2026-07-31 price cut, Terra/Luna consume FEWER credits inside subscriptions while sub prices/quotas stay unchanged. Codex Security CLI open-sourced 2026-07-29.

vendors.name: Windsurf / Devin Desktop
vendors.notes: Tab completions always free/unlimited. Devin itself bills by ACU: $20 platform fee + $2.25/ACU (Team from $500).

vendors.name: Trae
vendors.billing: token-based since 2026-02-24 (Basic + Bonus Usage; On-Demand overflow)
vendors.notes: Cheapest in category; SOLO multi-agent parallelism; ~25% off annual.

vendors.name: Gemini Code Assist
vendors.notes: Gemini CLI free tier: 1,000 requests/day, Apache 2.0. Google Antigravity: AI Pro $20 / AI Ultra $249.99.

vendors.name: Zhipu GLM Coding Plan
vendors.billing: CREDIT-BASED since 2026-07-30 (was prompt-count). Credits = (input*Ci + cached*Cc + output*Co)/10000

plans.note: existing users only; V1 users can buy until expiry, entry ~mid-Aug

vendors.peak_hours: Mon-Fri 14:00-18:00 UTC+8 at 1x; ALL other times incl. full weekends at 0.5x
vendors.notes: Tier ratios changed: Pro=6x Lite, Max=14x Lite (was 5x/20x). Legacy V1/V2 and team plans keep original pricing & rules. Models: GLM-5.2 / GLM-5-Turbo / GLM-4.7 (GLM-5.1/GLM-5 auto-route to 5.2). 20+ tools; OpenClaw runs at secondary scheduling priority. Official claim: up to 92% cheaper than pay-as-you-go GLM-5.2 API when using off-peak. HighSpeed tier available by application. ZCode 3.0 ADE uses in-house agent kernel, GLM-5.2 gets 1.5x quota inside ZCode.

vendors.name: Baidu Qianfan Token Plan (Personal)
vendors.billing: unified token quota across models (no model multiplier, no input/output/cache distinction)
vendors.notes: Coding Plan all tiers stopped selling 2026-07-13; Token Plan Personal fully open. THREE-LAYER throttling system fully removed - no peak-hour slowdown. Models: ERNIE-5.1, GLM-5.2, GLM-5.1, Kimi-K2.6, DeepSeek-V4-Pro/Flash. Tools: Cursor, Windsurf, Cline (10+), OpenAI + Anthropic protocol compatible. Dedicated personal API key isolated from postpaid/enterprise. Promo = daily 10:00 limited flash sale. Separate credit-based 'Token Welfare Pack': 50/100/200/400/800 CNY tiers.

vendors.name: Alibaba Model Studio (Bailian)
vendors.billing: Coding Plan = request count (shrinking); Token Plan = Credits unified metering

plans.status: daily 9:30 flash sale, sells out in minutes

plans.included: Credits unified; limited-time 10% daytime / 2% night; Qwen3.8-Max-Preview (2.4T) early access

vendors.notes: Coding Plan models: qwen3.5-plus, qwen3-max, qwen3-coder-next/plus, glm-5, glm-4.7, kimi-k2.5, minimax-m2.5. Restrictions: primary account only, NO API calls (coding tools only), no refunds/cancellation. No migration between Coding Plan and Token Plan.

vendors.name: Volcano Ark Coding Plan / Agent Plan

plans.included: 5x Lite + Auto model routing + priority scheduling

vendors.notes: Promo deadline EXTENDED from 2026-08-08 to 2026-08-27. Models: Doubao-Seed-2.1-turbo (new), Doubao-Seed-2.0-Code, Kimi-K2.6/K2.5, GLM-5.2 (new), GLM-5, DeepSeek-V3.2/V4. Purchase-limited since May. Rules: '08-27' is the ORDER deadline not the benefit duration; max 2 promo months per account; promo eligibility shared across new/renew/upgrade. Separate Agent Plan supports multimodal.

vendors.name: Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan
vendors.billing: Credits metering by actual token usage
vendors.notes: 2026-05-27 permanent API price cut up to 99% + Token Plan credits raised 5-8x at same price (0.6/2/7/16 hundred-million -> 41/110/380/820 hundred-million), with a one-time 'credits refresh reset' for existing users. Credit conversion: mimo-v2.5-pro cache-hit 2.5 credits/token, miss 300, output 600. Discounts: NIGHT 00:00-08:00 x0.8, first purchase 12% off, annual 12% off, first auto-renew 23% off. Models: mimo-v2.5-pro, mimo-v2.5, mimo-v2-omni, mimo-v2-flash, ASR, TTS (TTS free for limited time). Tools: Claude Code, OpenClaw, OpenCode, KiloCode, Roo Code, Cline, Codex, Cherry Studio, Zed, TRAE, CodeBuddy. OpenAI + Anthropic API compatible. Real-name required, no refunds.

vendors.name: MiniMax Token Plan
vendors.billing: monthly token quota, shared across all modalities
vendors.notes: Models: M3 (flagship, released 2026-05-31), M2.7, M2.7-highspeed + image/voice/music sharing the same quota. M2.7 Lite tier delisted. API-vlm repriced to 0.025 CNY/call from 2026-07-22. Tools: Claude Code, Roo Code, Kilo Code, Cline, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Droid, TRAE, Grok CLI, Cursor, OpenClaw.

vendors.name: Kimi Code Plan
vendors.billing: 5h token quota, refreshed every 7 days, no rollover

plans.included: K3 access, larger quota, multi-device shared
K3 1M context, 4 parallel agent tasks, cluster 8 subtasks, Kimi Claw group chat 10

vendors.notes: Kimi K3 released 2026-07-17 (2.8T params, 1M context), open weights late Jul; beat some US frontier models on benchmarks, cited as pressure behind OpenAI's 7/31 price cut. Max concurrency 30. Intl Kimi Code from $19/mo, API $3/$15 per MTok. Tools: Kimi CLI, Claude Code, Roo Code, Kimi Code for VS Code.

vendors.name: Tencent Cloud Coding Plan
vendors.notes: Coding Plan fully retired 2026-04-22 (page 404); moved to Token Plan (Credits metering). Former models: Tencent HY 2.0 Instruct, GLM-5, Kimi-K2.5, MiniMax-M2.7. Former tools: OpenClaw, CodeBuddy, Claude Code, Cline, Cursor.

vendors.name: KwaiKAT Coding Plan
vendors.notes: Launched Jul 2026 with KAT-Coder-Pro V2.5 agentic coding model (long-horizon tasks, multi-framework RL).

model_token_prices_per_MTok.note: unchanged; new Fast mode = 2.5x speed at 2x price, replaces Priority Processing

trends: Domestic Coding Plans enter a REPRICING phase: Zhipu raised CN prices 130-261% while lifting purchase limits - 'cheap but sold out' is being replaced by 'available but pricier'. New Pro 538 CNY (~$74) is now near Z.ai intl $72
Overseas moves the opposite way: OpenAI cut Luna 80%, pushing agent-capable models into the price band of old small models. The CN-vs-overseas price gap is narrowing fast
Billing paradigm migration complete: request-count -> token/credit/points across Copilot, Cursor, Codex, Zhipu, Baidu, Alibaba, Tencent, Xiaomi
TIME-OF-DAY pricing is the new lever: Zhipu 0.5x off-peak incl. all weekends, Xiaomi 0.8x nights, Alibaba 2% night rate - shifting heavy work off-peak yields 20-80% savings and is widely overlooked
Subscription price is a floor, not a ceiling: heavy Copilot users saw 10-50x list price
Model routing is the main cost lever; vendor in-house models (MAI-Code-1-Flash, Composer, Doubao, MiMo) keep high-frequency agent traffic on cheap rails
Agent-first product consensus: Zhipu ZCode ADE, Cursor Composer 2.5 + Mission Control, Copilot Agent Skills GA all landed in the same window - the human role shifts from author to reviewer
